content:
On iPhone: download the last fm offical app, and then go on iPhone Settings > Music then turn on “use listening history”. You have to manually scrobble the songs by clicking on scan in the app it’s not automatic like Spotify. Also it will only scrobbles songs you have saved to your library, discovering new music on playlists won’t register on the app.

On desktop: download the last fm offical desktop app, it will Scrobble automatically

On web player: download the web scrobbler chrome extension, it will Scrobble automatically

Apple Music sucks ass tbh, I can’t wait to go back to Spotify after my free trial ends
